errorCategory.title: Authentication Required
errorCategory.description: Server returned 401. Response body: Status 401 - Error: Invalid credentials
errorCategory.guidance:
**Actual server response:** Status 401 - Error: Invalid credentials

**Likely cause:** The server rejected the email/password pair. This is NOT a token problem — the user either doesn't exist with that email, or the password doesn't match.

**Check:**
1. Did a prior test (register) create this exact email+password?
2. Is the login test's payload email field using the SAME email as register? (Dev MCP patches this automatically via _patch_login_payloads_with_cached_creds — if you see this on POST /api/auth/login, verify that patch fired.)
3. Are email and password both populated (not {{{{dynamic:…}}}} left as a literal)?
